raw.name: Sur Kharvaa
raw.description:
Sûr kharvaa - archery. Loose one arrow of Python at the target: POST its
raw bytes to `/shoot`, and it runs in a throwaway sandbox. The target is
not hidden - read it at `/target.py`.

Striking the target is only the first mark. The range belongs to the
keeper, and only the keeper may read the record.

> [!CONNECTION]
> https://sur-kharvaa-k2xk2v3n.challenge.2026.haruulzangi.mn
raw.author: bekkaze
